entry_lab_recovered.title: Entry Laboratory
entry_lab_recovered.text: The first floor is usable again. The tower responds to simple brews, but much of it remains asleep.

archive_revelation.title: Archive Revelation
archive_revelation.text: The archive timeline resolves: the wizard sealed each floor not to hoard power, but to keep the tower from consuming every living system bound into it. Leaving was the final act of restraint.

greenhouse_expanded.title: Greenhouse Expanded
greenhouse_expanded.text: Brin reset the old planter wards. A new moon bed is active on the north side of the greenhouse, and the town finally has reason to believe the valley can recover in more than scraps.

first_true_brew.title: First Useful Brew
first_true_brew.text: The first successful brew was not important because it proved the tower still worked. It mattered because someone in town could actually use it.

first_town_relief.title: First Town Relief
first_town_relief.text: Mira's first delivered draught changed the conversation in the square. The tower is no longer just a ruin above town. It has begun helping again.

containment_stable.title: Habitats Stabilized
containment_stable.text: Lyra tuned the habitat wards. Gentle collection from tower creatures can now support regular alchemical work.

containment_started.title: Containment Floor
containment_started.text: The creature habitats are stable enough to hold gentle tower specimens. Managed collection can begin.

first_rune_imbuing.title: First Rune Imbuing
first_rune_imbuing.text: The workshop accepted a finished potion and changed its behavior after the fact. The tower's later methods were more modular than the entry lab ever suggested.

observatory_ending.title: Observatory Ending
observatory_ending.text: At the tower's highest lens, the missing wizard's final path resolved into a choice to leave the tower alive rather than master it forever.

statuses.archive_timeline_complete: The archive timeline snaps into place.
statuses.archive_timeline_incomplete: The archive still has missing pieces.
statuses.archive_reconstruction_ready: Ready: final timeline can be reconstructed.
statuses.archive_reconstruction_missing: Final timeline still has missing pieces.
statuses.greenhouse_unlock: The tower greenhouse unlocks upstairs after your tenth brew. If it can be restored, the town may have its first reliable growing refuge again.

overlays.observatory_epilogue: The restored tower resolves its own history through the lens above the clouds. The wizard did not vanish in failure. They chose distance over domination, leaving a machine of rooms that only remains safe when used with restraint. The tower is not yours to conquer. It is yours to tend.
overlays.observatory_footer: Enter or Esc to step back

epilogue_beats.line: Below the lens the whole valley is flowering at once and the bed rows behind the square are carrying. Neither was restored to the tower. They were restored to the ground.

Three unsigned orders came, were filled, and were collected, and no fourth ever arrived. Somebody outside this valley wanted to know whether the tower was working again. They found out. That question stays open, and it was never yours to close.

The infirmary's back shelf is empty. Wren kept it twenty years for the cases she could not fix, so that she had something to do with her hands. It carries the day's stock now, which is a different sort of record entirely.

The valley asks for the best thing you can make now rather than the quickest, and gets it. Brin still writes the cost under every notice — nine plants, ten years a hand's width — which is the only reason the asking stays honest.

The eleven months taken out of the logs are back in them, and they are working notes rather than a testament. Whoever sealed this place proved to themselves what it would do if left running, wrote it down, then removed the working so nobody could be persuaded by it. You put it back anyway.
The southern pass is worked through the winter now and the waystation at the top of it is lit every night. For eleven years this was the valley the road went past. It is a place the road stops at.
There are bloomwings in the habitat and in the wild rows, and a plant the valley had finished losing is growing in a bed upstairs. It needed somebody to notice that eleven was not ninety.

The square grows its own and the tower's terraces are cut back into work along the lines somebody laid down twenty years ago. Two people who spent a decade blaming themselves for the ground are, this season, simply gardening.

Goods move on the outer road after dark and the board in the square carries standing orders rather than emergencies. The tower is a line in a ledger now, which is the only kind of trust that survives the people who extended it.

The well row has been quiet since it was treated. Two years of headaches that everyone including the apothecary had written down as strain, and the answer was a bucket and somebody willing to read their own handwriting.
The slope under the wall is terraced and planted again. Brin followed the original bed lines rather than laying his own, which is the closest thing to a monument anyone in this valley builds.
The habitats hold, the rune benches hum, and every floor that was sealed is being used for the work it was cut for. Restraint turned out not to mean leaving them shut.
